gaps_resolved.symptom: Viewport displayed procedural rainbow-colored proxy box faces rather than internal volume.
gaps_resolved.root_cause: Shader sampled proxy mesh vertex UVs instead of raymarching through 3D scalar texture.
gaps_resolved.resolution: Replaced vertex-color shader with raymarching WGSL/GLSL sampler evaluating 3D transfer function LUT and wet mask.

gaps_resolved.symptom: All 7 timeline days displayed identical frame or stuck in PROBING.
gaps_resolved.root_cause: Cache key omitted time_index and readiness probe poll handler lacked transition dispatch.
gaps_resolved.resolution: Added time_index and generation tokens to cache invalidation and updated AppStore state machine.

gaps_resolved.symptom: UI panels overlapped central viewport and obscured interactive controls.
gaps_resolved.root_cause: Absolute positioning without container min-width and conflicting z-index hierarchy.
gaps_resolved.resolution: Refactored App.tsx layout to CSS Grid with collapsible drawers and responsive breakout rules.
